title: Drone-only TFR set up over Picatinny Arsenal before Thanksgiving

tellings.quote: about the situation is that there was a TFR set up over Pikatini Arsenal a month prior like before Thanksgiving

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he retrieved a UFO with his helicopter, says that in 2024 a temporary flight restriction, an official ban on flying in a stretch of airspace, was set up for drones over the Picatinny Arsenal, a military site in New Jersey. He tells Michels it went up a month earlier, "before Thanksgiving," which, if so, would mean the airspace was being closed ahead of whatever followed.
